country.h1MoreTemplate: In {country} a dollar costs {gap}% more than the official rate
country.h1LessTemplate: In {country} a dollar costs {gap}% less than the official rate
country.h1SameTemplate: In {country} a dollar costs about the same as the official rate
country.subRateTemplate: The official rate is {rate} {ccy} to the dollar. People pay {street} for a dollar.
country.subLossTemplate: So anyone paid or changing money at the official rate loses close to {share}% of the value against what a dollar really goes for. The sum: {rate} {ccy} divided by {street} is about {buys}%, so you get {buys}% of the value and lose {share}%. That is the same fact as paying {gap}% more this hour.
country.leadTemplate: What people pay in {country} comes from a local exchange, compared with the official rate.
country.metaTemplate: Checked {time}. The headline is the middle price of the last 24 hours.
country.tileLabelDepth: How much you could buy now
country.tileLabelRoundTrip: Cost of buying and selling straight back
country.tileDepthSubTemplate: within {pct}% of the best price, so you pay about the same
country.tileRoundTripSubTemplate: of your money lost if you buy a dollar and sell it straight back
country.tilePayNone: priced from an exchange, not person to person offers
country.tileRateNone: not published for this source yet
country.tileDepthNone: no order depth published for this source yet
country.chartNoteTemplate: A point here is one percentage point of the gap. Each step along the line is one day. The last step is this hour, while the headline is the middle of 24 hours, so they differ slightly.
country.moveAfterRiseTemplate: Most of the rise came after {date}.
country.moveAfterFallTemplate: Most of the fall came after {date}.
country.moveGradualTemplate: It changed gradually across the full period.
country.stepsNoRateBodyTemplate: This price comes from an exchange order book ({source}), not person to person offers. The figure is real, from {file}. The raw price and official rate are not in a published file yet.
country.stepsIntroTemplate: In {country}, people buy stablecoins, digital coins meant to stay worth one dollar, from each other on Binance P2P, an app where people trade directly. Each coin is worth one dollar, so what people pay for it is what a dollar really costs there. Under each step is the public data file it comes from.
country.stepOfferTemplate: The {n} cheapest offers to sell a dollar, middle price {median} {ccy}. The middle price is the one in the middle when the offers are ranked from cheapest to dearest.
country.stepRateTemplate: The official rate at the same moment, {rate} {ccy}.
country.stepRateNote: published once a day, so it can be hours old
country.stepDivideSameTemplate: {median} divided by {rate} is about the same this hour.
country.stepHeadlineTemplate: The headline is the middle of the last 24 hours, {gap}%. A full day keeps one odd hour from moving it.
country.stepDepthTemplate: {held} of the {priced} sellers, about {amount}, are within {pct}% of the best price. That is how much you could buy before the price rises.
country.stepDepthMovedTemplate: {held} of the {priced} sellers, about {amount}, are within {pct}% of the best price. Beyond that, the price moves.
country.historySegmentSourceTemplate: The dashed line before {since} is {venue}'s own price history, compared with {fxSource}, from {first} to {last}. It is labelled {label}: the exchange reported it and we did not watch it happen. It is never counted in the published number above.
country.historyStartTemplate: History starts {date}, the first day we collected a price here.
country.historyShowTemplate: Show the full record, {first} to now
country.historyOwnOnly: Show only the period we collected ourselves
country.recordRange: On most days it sits between {lo}% and {hi}%.
country.recordWidest: Today's gap is the widest in {scope} since {first}.
country.recordNearWidest: Today's gap is among the widest in {scope} since {first}.
country.recordNarrowest: Today's gap is the narrowest in {scope} since {first}.
country.recordNearNarrowest: Today's gap is among the narrowest in {scope} since {first}.
country.recordNormal: Today's gap is in its normal range for {scope} since {first}.

countryData.historyStart: Our record starts {date}, the first day we collected a price here.
countryData.leadBook: The official rate is {rate} {ccy} per dollar. On the exchanges where people in {country} trade stablecoins, one costs {street}. A stablecoin is a coin that stays worth one US dollar.
countryData.leadP2p: The official rate is {rate} {ccy} per dollar. On Binance, in a marketplace where people sell stablecoins to each other, one costs {street}. A stablecoin is a coin that stays worth one US dollar.
countryData.sourceLine: This price is set {sourceWords}. Other sources on the chart are for comparison and do not change it.
countryData.sourceRule: A country's price comes from person-to-person offers where at least 10 people are selling, otherwise from exchange prices, otherwise from broker quotes.
